question: In a certain code language, 'QZDH' is written as '51', 'PLMQ' is written as '54'. What is the code for 'DNRB' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917e7e4a037fb946fafa0b16de664d6f0ce32ab76e5c2c9b848dc1f771a7f81.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'QZDH' is written as '51',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09f63d4864ac8a24e53fdbb7bb7245e5a333e65fc5bf6710de7514f3c4506e15.png] 

'PLMQ' is written as '54'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76d83d262cbb2ef09b46811b71de4a37e781d3b0d1cfb62f27c93a5527ab8771.png] 

Similarly, the code for '**DNRB**':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eada1e06de9b2c3ab3fc4f2e93b8c3decae059522083f692fa4b30cad87e3f95.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "34".
